_comment: THE Android build toolchain, pinned. One source for both places a build can run:
• the Docker image (native/android/Dockerfile runs toolchain.mjs inside itself), and
Both install exactly these bytes, so moving from Docker to a local SDK changes nothing
about the build. Gradle reads compileSdk and buildTools from here too, so the SDK the
installer lays down and the SDK the build asks for cannot disagree.
Every archive is verified against its sha256 before it is unpacked. The two checksums
were cross-checked on 2026-09-24 against the publisher's own listing: the JDK against
api.adoptium.net, the command-line tools against BOTH developer.android.com/studio
(sha256) and Google's repository2-3.xml (sha1 040d3996…). sdkmanager verifies the
platform and build-tools packages itself against that same repository manifest.
Gradle itself is pinned (with its sha256) in gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.properties,
and every Maven artifact in gradle/verification-metadata.xml.
